notes.title: More clues and replaced some light bulbs!
notes.content:
Today we are happy to announce we have added a few more clues to help guide you on your path home! We have also decided to provide you with a better illuminated path.    


This update also comes with some MAJOR long time bug fixes with the largest ones being the stuttering found by the bio lab,  Issues inside the cave, and making several click targets larger.

notes.title: New Clues!
notes.content: You asked for it we made it! We have included additional clues to help you with the newly finished final stage!
